errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly states the Kupfer values for Germany in 2022 and 2023 as 11.4% and 11.4%, but the figure shows 11.3% and 2.2%.
The machine description incorrectly states the Nickel values for Germany in 2023 as 25.1%, but the figure shows 11.4%.
The machine description incorrectly states the Aluminium values for the EU in 2022 and 2023 as 1.7% and 1.8%, but the figure shows 2.8% and 1.7%.
The machine description correctly states the Kupfer values for the EU in 2021 and 2023 but incorrectly states the 2022 value as 5.1%, while the figure shows 5.1%.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für 2021, 2022 und 2023 sind jeweils dunkelblau, blau und violett gefärbt.
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly states the color mapping for the years. The figure shows blue for 2021, violet for 2022, and gray for 2023.
The machine description does not mention that the chart represents the share of Russian imports of industrial raw materials in percentage terms.
